actor_type.description: One employee's career at the company, from requisition through exit; carries the skill/facility identity that routes their shifts and the burnout state that drives attrition.
One customer's tenure: prospect -> active -> lapsing -> churned, with win-back; owns the customer entity's lifecycle.
One customer order from placement to rest; after a failed delivery the same actor also walks the support_case journey.
One supplier order: raised -> in_transit -> received; receipt restocks the targeted stock line.

status.description: The booking holds a live reserved opening, pending attend.
The subject attended the confirmed opening (terminal).
The subject drew a no-show at the confirmed opening; the slot is wasted, not returned (terminal).
The booking was released before attend by an explicit cancel (terminal).
The booking was released before attend because the subject's patience expired (terminal).
The booking's opening was cut by a diary cancel_rebook resolution and rebooked to a successor (terminal).
The booking's opening was cut by a diary forfeit resolution with no successor (terminal).

booking_discipline.description: Assigns the earliest eligible opening — an eligible free-list entry when one exists, else the diary's cursor.

diary_type.description: A facility's roster calendar; booking a slot schedules a shift, and the no-show draw at the opening is the sick day.
A facility's delivery-window calendar; the no-show draw at the opening is customer-not-home, the delivery-failure mechanism.

entity_type.description: A live customer account: order-placement candidate (weighted by propensity) and carrier of the support-written satisfaction signal.
One catalog line: category, demand popularity, and the on-hand count that dispatch depletes and receipts replenish.

current_state.description: Routing point for the generated starting population, before each veteran joins its real journey.
Kickoff complete; the actor now lives in its routed journey.
Entry gate for a career: new requisitions head into the hiring pipeline, veterans step straight onto the floor.
An approved opening awaiting a sourcing effort.
The role is being searched: postings, screens, interviews.
An offer is out and awaiting acceptance.
Hired but not yet useful: training, equipment, ramp-up.
A working member of the crew, rostered onto shifts.
Resignation handed in; still rostered through the notice period.
The career at this company has ended.
Between shifts: bind the crew pool and check whether this person is still on the roster.
Holding a booked slot on the facility roster until the shift starts.
Working a shift; the crew pool holds this person's capacity.
Off sick after a no-show; recovering before rejoining the roster.
No bookable shift was available; waiting before trying again.
The shift cycle has closed; re-entry books the next one while employment lasts.
Entry gate for a tenure: new prospects enter the funnel, established customers go straight to activation.
Evaluating the retailer before a first purchase.
The account opens: the customer record is minted here.
A live, buying customer.
Engagement has faded; the account is drifting toward churn.
The tenure has ended and the account is closed.
The order exists and its product line is chosen.
Waiting for the chosen line to have units on hand.
Holding (or queuing for) a picker while the order is picked.
Picking paused: the facility's picker pool is offline.
Picked goods being packed for dispatch.
Packed and holding a booked delivery window.
On a van with a driver, en route to the customer.
Handed over to the customer.
Delivered and inside the return window.
A return is on its way back to the warehouse.
The returned unit is back on the shelf; the order is closed.
The order completed without a return.
The delivery failed; a support ticket is being opened.
The order ended in a failed delivery; support owns the aftermath.
A failed-delivery ticket exists and awaits triage.
Queued for (or being assigned) a support agent; a case whose queue wait outlives its patience escalates instead.
An agent is working the case.
Escalated for senior handling, jumping the agent queue.
A senior agent is working the escalated case.
The case is closed; the order actor retires.
The purchase order exists and its restock target is chosen.
Goods are with the supplier or on the way in.
Goods received and shelved; the purchase order closes.

journey_type.description: Kickoff router for the generated starting population: veterans go to the employment journey, established customers to the lifecycle journey.
One career: the hiring pipeline (whose onboarding delay is the workforce loop's inertia), the burnout-weighted attrition roll, and the notice period the hiring aggregate counts.

The roster loop, one journey instance per shift: book a facility slot, roll the sick-day draw at the opening, and move the matching crew pool's capacity +1/-1 around each attended shift. Re-entry (gated on still being employed) books the next shift.
One tenure: activation mints the customer entity; the active poll mixes natural (loyalty-weighted) lapse with the scarred-lapse gate on support-written satisfaction; churn tombstones the entity.

One order's flow: stock gate and depletion, picker contention, the delivery-window booking whose no-show draw is customer-not-home, the return window, and the failure edge that opens a support case on this same actor.

The failed-delivery ticket on the same order actor: agent contention, queue-patience expiry escalating a case to senior handling that jumps the queue, and the distress-clearing resolution the satisfaction aggregate reads.
One supplier order: target a popular stock line, wait out the supplier lead time, and restock on receipt.

discipline.description: Waiters promoted by highest declared priority, ties by earliest enqueue.
A newly-arriving higher-priority actor displaces a lower-priority holder; 1-server queues only.

on_full.description: The seize waits in the queue for a slot to free.
The seize is rejected immediately and routed to its on_rejected handler.
The seize resamples a delay and is retried.
The seize is routed to its on_reroute handler.

resource_type.description: A facility crew's working capacity (pickers north/south, drivers north/south); each attended shift raises it for the shift's duration.
The central support desk's working capacity; support-skill attendance raises it. Priority discipline lets escalated cases jump the queue.

scenario_description: A regional retailer with its own warehouse and delivery fleet: employment, rostering, customer acquisition, orders, fulfillment, support, returns, and replenishment on one shared cast, with workforce, service, and reorder loops closed by mechanism.
